title: Contribution of ICG Angiography in the Detection of Parathyroids and the Prevention of Hypoparathyroidism Post Total Thyroidectomy
official: Contribution of ICG Angiography in the Detection of Parathyroids and the Prevention of Hypoparathyroidism Post Total Thyroidectomy (HYPOCAAVI)
summary: Main objective: Compare the incidence of albumin-corrected hypocalcaemia (blood calcium less than 2 mmol/L, a sign associated with hypoparathyroidism) postoperatively between the group using indocyanine green and the group not using indocyanine green.

interventions.name: INFRACYANINE 25 mg/10 mL, poudre et solvant pour solution injectable

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Patients requiring total thyroidectomy
2. Signed consent
3. Patient covered by a social security scheme
Exclusion criteria:
1. Patients under 18 years of age
2. Protected adult or person incapable of giving consent to the study
3. Pregnant and breast-feeding women
4. Total thyroidectomy (removal of the remaining thyroid lobe in a patient who has already had a hemi thyroidectomy)
5. Previous thyroid or parathyroid surgery
6. Refusal to participate
7. Known allergic reaction to indocyanine green (ICG)
8. Women of childbearing age not using an adequate method of contraception
sponsor: Centre Hospitalier Regional Et Universitaire De Brest
